compile-symbols.comment: < … > is the compile-time symbol sigil (e.g. <card>). Colored wherever a <…> ends the line.

lifecycle-hooks.comment: @ is the lifecycle-hook sigil (@define, @data:define, @visuals:define, @card.tile). The engine enters here.

engine-symbols.comment: :: is the engine-symbol sigil (e.g. ::corpus>) — what the engine stores and sorts. (Single : is a label; double :: is an engine symbol.)

references.comment: Each maximal run is colored by its leading delimiter: $ (dereferences a <…> compile symbol — same color as <card>), :: (engine symbol), : (label), & (slot address), * (slot value), . (field/aspect). The delimiter and the name after it share one color; a run ends at the next delimiter or whitespace. :: is matched before : so the double colon wins. Exception: the .<stack>.<offset> coordinate right after `slot` is colored by stack id (hex/top/bottom).

patterns.comment: slot coordinate — hex stack: .0.<offset> (offset = any digits). Colored by stack id.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.stack.hex.rd-dsl

patterns.comment: ^ system call — engine-native function (^biome, ^seed), invoked with `call`
patterns.name: support.function.engine-call.rd-dsl

patterns.comment: control flow — branch, jump, call, return, stack drop
patterns.name: keyword.control.flow.rd-dsl

patterns.comment: conditions — operators that produce a boolean
patterns.name: keyword.operator.comparison.rd-dsl

patterns.comment: actions — verbs that read/mutate state or generate values (normalize/scatter/random write a slot; count/key/recall push lookups)
patterns.name: keyword.other.action.rd-dsl

constants.comment: language constants — direction tokens and the math constant pi
constants.name: constant.language.rd-dsl

numbers.comment: integer or float literal (floats: any number with a decimal part)
numbers.name: constant.numeric.rd-dsl
